title: maytenus ilicifolia
intro: Maytenus ilicifolia, commonly known as Mina or False Holly, is a plant species in the family Celastraceae. It is native to the subtropical regions of South America and has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits. The plant has been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which provide therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of Maytenus ilicifolia include triterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
